title: Reconcile Bronze, Silver and Gold snapshots
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. cloud_target represents the published Gold order snapshot, at order_id grain. Source has event grain: choose the greatest event_id for each order among arrived batches and updated_at <= as_of. Compare Source→Bronze, Bronze→Silver and Silver→Target by key, customer, exact amount, timestamp and event ID. Sum each edge's differing FULL JOIN rows plus duplicated order-key groups in the three outputs. An equal-count key swap remains a defect; the score counts rule violations, not unique bad orders.
learning_objectives: Reconcile Bronze, Silver and Gold snapshots
Separate execution, quality and incomplete evidence.
